svg.text: The mīm, first letter of the name in the wordmark's Kufi: its loop the halqa, its counter the nuqṭa (a lozenge), its baseline
the kashida with the madder thread. It joins to the LEFT, into the name, as in the RTL flow of the wordmark.
Keep one nuqṭa of air around the mark: the diagonal of its lozenge
counter (outlined in madder), measured at the size in use.
In the horizontal lockup the same nuqṭa separates the name from the
mark. Closer, its kashida reads as a letter joined to the name
(a second mīm). The mark always sits at the Arabic reading start, the right.
Mark, small cut (one colour, no thread)
One colour: black, white, ink or brass. On dark grounds use the thinned files (-white, -mono-brass, -night): light on dark looks heavier.
Night: brass + thread on tent black
Over photographs (the hero skies), only on a calm dark area, brass or white. On Sadu bands, wool colours or busy patterns, use the app tile.
no longer the mīm of the name)
Also: no outline, no thread in the small cut, nothing in or over the counter, never the old halqa icon. The mark never sits to the left of the Arabic name.
Masters: docs/brand/mim/master (symbol), docs/brand/mim/lockups. Web icons: front/src/assets/brand/app-icon.svg, front/public/favicon.svg.
Rasters: front/scripts/brand/render-icons.mjs. Fonts: Reem Kufi 700 and Marcellus 400 outlined (SIL OFL 1.1). Trademark search: not done.
